profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Infrastructure
profile.summary: A software solution engineer experienced in building complex applications and software designs across various domains and industries. Professional go-getter with experience on designing, configuring, testing, deploying, automating and maintaining Azure services.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Burr Ridge, Illinois, United States · On-site

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Conducted Java C++, and Ruby on Rails programming lab sessions for undergraduate students to assist them with advanced programming concepts using Object-Oriented methods. Led a team of undergraduate students and worked on an internal school project for a course management system that allows enrollment, course research, assignments, and coursework management.
• Provided feedback and performed research along with students to help them explore creative solutions using cutting-edge methods. Studied User experience for two popular travel websites using advanced HCI methodologies such as SUS, accessibility, case studies, focus groups, KLM, Cognitive Walkthrough, etc to determine which model is better and more likely to succeed with usability.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for playing a key role in various aspects of the SDLC cycle. Worked closely with
various teams to understand requirements as user stories and developed product that meets their needs the best.
• Worked on a Migration project(Azure Migration) which involved moving to azure completely from an on-premise system. Worked on resource management and employee time management software.
• Researched, designed, and programmed a Multi-Platform Xamarin Application for UWP (Universal Windows Platform), iOS, and Android Devices. Came up with a solution that eliminates code repetition and extra maintenance.
• Implemented various azure services for Backend processing, Database Management, Authentication, push notification, and Monitoring on Cloud (Azure).

projects.title: Course Scheduler/Enrollment Tool
projects.description: We built an interactive course scheduling web application using Ruby on Rails that would serve as an interface among an institution's registrar, instructors/faculty, and students. The objection of this project was to design a graduate course scheduler that can be used to determine valid combinations of courses a student may enroll in the next semester. Learning includes Ruby on Rails, Bootstrap, Postgresql, AJAX, AngularJS Version Control using Github, Web Services using REST API, Agile Development, third party gems like Devise, Omniauth and cancancan, and Project Tracking using Trello.

projects.title: Make File Utility for Device Detection
projects.description: Our Team created a small KLM (kernel loadable module) which identifies a USB device when it is plugged in to the computer. Information about the USB vendor and product is printed to the kernel logs via printk. The Project was part of a graduate course called Operating System Principles(COSC 519). The main purpose of our project was to describe in detail how makefiles can be used to build and install external loadable modules and demonstrate how makefiles can be used to implement continuous integration. Learning Includes makefile, KBuild for Linux Kernal, Device Drivers.
